bugs.title: Employer saw worker-perspective attendance copy
bugs.steps: Open an in-progress shift where the worker self-checked-in but the employer hasn't confirmed presence.
bugs.expected: Employer sees employer-addressed copy ('Người làm đã check-in. Vui lòng xác nhận có mặt nếu đúng.'); never worker-addressed text.
bugs.actual: The page reused worker-perspective lifecycle strings (lifecycle.mismatch.workerOnly/employerOnly), so the employer saw text addressed to the worker ('Nhà tuyển dụng đã xác nhận bạn có mặt…').
bugs.fix: Added src/domain/attendanceState.ts with a canonical state machine + attendanceCopyKey(state, role) returning attendance.copy.{worker|employer|admin}.{state}. Wired worker dashboard UpcomingShiftCard to worker copy and employer detail page to employer copy. Added per-role i18n strings for the 5 banner states.
tests: src/__tests__/coreStability9.test.ts (role-aware copy keys are distinct, non-banner states undefined)

bugs.title: Worker could check out mid-shift (before shift end)
bugs.steps: Self-check-in to a shift, then look at the check-out CTA before the shift ends (e.g. a 15:55–16:00 shift at 15:55).
bugs.expected: Check-out only opens AFTER the shift ends, within a 60-minute grace window [end, end+60min].
bugs.actual: canCheckOut opened at start (now >= start), so the CTA appeared mid-shift.
bugs.fix: canCheckOut now requires now >= end (window [end, end+60min]). Still requires the worker's own checkInAt (CS8 Part 4 preserved). Worker dashboard checkout CTA is gated by canCheckOut so it stays hidden mid-shift. Updated lifecycle.checkOut.outsideWindow copy.
tests: src/__tests__/coreStability9.test.ts (15:50/15:55/15:59 hidden; 16:00/16:01 visible; +61min hidden; employer-only never unlocks)
updated src/__tests__/coreStability8.test.ts + phase10cStab1.test.ts to the new end-gating rule

bugs.title: No canonical attendance state machine for consistent role-aware gating/copy
bugs.steps: Compare attendance status text/gating across worker and employer pages.
bugs.expected: One derived state drives copy + gating consistently across roles.
bugs.actual: Attendance facts (self check-in vs employer mark-present vs clock) were scattered across ad-hoc booleans.
bugs.fix: deriveAttendanceState(application, shift, nowIso) returns 11 canonical states from status + checkInAt + markedPresentAt + the wall clock (terminal/dispute first, then the two-sided presence matrix gated by the clock). Pure projection — never stored.
tests: src/__tests__/coreStability9.test.ts (11-state matrix incl. before/at/after start+end transitions)

bugs.title: No worker skill XP / level progression
bugs.steps: Complete several confirmed shifts in a job category.
bugs.expected: Worker accrues XP and levels up per category; profile shows level + XP progress; employers see skill level.
bugs.actual: WorkerSkillScore only carried a rating-derived 0-100 score; no levelling loop.
bugs.fix: Added WorkerSkillScore.xp + src/domain/skillProgression.ts (levels 1-5 at 0/50/120/250/500; +10 completed/+5 5★/+3 4★/+2 no-dispute/0 disputed). awardSkillXp chained into confirmCompletion. SkillProgressBar component on worker profile (full) + WorkerSummaryRow (compact).
tests: src/__tests__/coreStability9.test.ts (levelForXp thresholds, xpForCompletion, skillProgress fraction, awardSkillXp create/accumulate/disputed)

bugs.title: No availability blocks / free-schedule job suggestions
bugs.steps: Declare free time and look for shifts that fit it.
bugs.expected: Worker can mark 'available' time (non-blocking) and the job list / dashboard suggest shifts that fit free time + skills, labelled by match quality.
bugs.actual: ScheduleBlock only modelled BUSY time; no availability concept and no free-schedule suggestions.
bugs.fix: Added ScheduleBlock.kind ('busy'|'available'); available blocks excluded from the application-conflict gate. Schedule dialog busy/available toggle + calendar availableSlot variant. src/domain/availabilityMatch.ts rule-based weighted scorer (time 40/location 25/skill 25/wage 10; excludes busy/approved overlaps). Shifts page 'Phù hợp lịch rảnh' sort + per-card match pills; worker dashboard 'Ca làm phù hợp' recommendation section ('Gợi ý theo lịch rảnh và kỹ năng của bạn.').
tests: src/__tests__/coreStability9.test.ts (fitsInsideAvailability, matchLabel, scoreShiftForWorker exclusions + high score, suggestShiftsForWorker ranking/drop)
e2e/23-core-stability-9.spec.ts (availability sort toggle + match pill; schedule kind toggle)

bugs.title: Demo never disclosed that data lives only in the browser
bugs.steps: Use the app and look for any statement about data persistence.
bugs.expected: An honest, site-wide note that demo data is stored in the browser and clearing cache loses it; no claim of a backend.
bugs.fix: Added a site-wide footer note: 'Dữ liệu demo đang lưu trên trình duyệt. Xóa cache sẽ mất dữ liệu.' Extended backend-migration-plan.md §11 with the four CS9 concepts (attendance projection, skill XP column, availability kind, recommendation compute-on-read).

productDecisions.decision: Attendance copy is keyed per (state, role). Only 5 states render a banner; worker/employer strings are always distinct.
Check-out opens at shift END (window [end, end+60min]), not start, and still requires the worker's own self check-in.
Skill XP is a separate field from the rating score; awarded only on confirmCompletion; disputed shifts award 0. Levels 1-5.
Availability is a 'kind' discriminator on ScheduleBlock (reusing the existing slice; no schema bump). Available blocks never gate applications.
Recommendations are rule-based (NOT AI): time 40% / location 25% / skill 25% / wage 10%; conflicting shifts excluded; labels Rất phù hợp/Phù hợp/Cần cân nhắc.
Backend status is stated truthfully site-wide; no partial/hidden backend exists. Data is localStorage-only until the migration plan's Phase 1 ships.
